> **⚠ THE `delta` ABOVE IS A LEGAL SUBTRACTION AND THE NAMED WINDOW IS WHY.** The `s214-D5` clause homed at #272 makes `delta` meaningful ONLY when both terms read the SAME window. They do here: `_checkin.py` at this seat reads the conductor's own transcript — its first user record is Dave's opener, and the boot figure it reports (75,740) is the one the brief DECLARES, to the token. #270 wrote `unobservable` because its wrap sub read a separately-windowed transcript; #271, #272 and #279 computed it and each named the window. This one names it too. ⚠ `replay` — what reading this report back costs the conductor — is not observable from inside the sub; the conductor may append the measured figure at the #281 opener.
